Before you submit your remix, make sure that you followed all of the rules:

1. It is polite and REMIX ETIQUETTE to comment "Remixing..." in the comments before starting a remix, so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, then don't remix if someone has commented "Remixing...".

2. DO NOT BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES!! That means nothing too scary or vulgar & no swear words!

3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking rules list without permission! Furthermore, don't delete any of these rules or instructions & don't completely change the project title either!

4. Don't delete or destructively modify anything you didn't make! You are allowed to do this though if something breaks any rules or the Community Guidelines or if you need to fix a bug or glitch.

5. Don't make your characters too large, that would make it hard to see. I would suggest scaling your character IN THE COSTUME EDITOR or using the size offset block to match the size of the other characters before making your other costumes.
.
6. Please refrain from adding any static images for characters, even if you attempt animate them, background included or not (EG: A PNG or JPEG of a Minecraft mob or some other thing).

7. I don't recommend adding any singular characters that appear to be 2 separate characters (EG: Mario & Luigi both as 1 character), unless they are stuck together with no feasible way to physically detach them OR if one of them appears in a stunned costume of the other.

8. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the Community Guidelines. If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, utilize the "audio exemption" functionality to make sure you can't.

9. You can add music, but make sure there aren't too many songs so that way the game doesn't lag too much.

10. You can add yourself to the thumbnail, but please don't delete any characters off it or completely change it altogether!

11. The max player limit is 50, if you go past this, the game will run into some problems...

You can add your character's costumes and sound clips to add your character to the game!

If you set the "Seconds per run frame:" to an empty input, the interval will be faster than 0 seconds.

You can also add as many Ouch voice clips and footstep sounds, just make sure to apply the changes to this custom block above.

If your character's costumes are too big or too small compared to the grey box costumes provided, you can use the size offset input to adjust the size of your character without effecting any hitbox sizes.

Make sure to add some color to make sure they have been pause by a pause marble!

Make sure to change the name from [ NAME HERE ] or else they won't participate in the game!
